_comment: Known table of handler factories that take no arguments (ADR-DOE-API-002 R4). The ADR deftest cross-checks it against the list from tools/handler_factory_census.py. A factory missing from the table is red, and a row missing from the list is also red (the table only shrinks along with the code). verdict is one of: 呼びごとの状態 (per-call state; may stay a factory -- each call builds new state), 直す (no config and no per-call state -- write in why the card that turns it into a plain handler), factory でない (something the reader took for a factory but is not).

rows.why: Each call builds a new InMemoryStorage (a separate cache per call)
Each call builds a new InMemoryStorage (a separate memo per call)
Each call builds a new listeners table (a separate pub/sub per call)
Each call builds a new watches table (a separate set of watches per call)
Each call builds a new armed table and firing task (a separate timer list per call)
Calls progress_bars(tqdm) and each call builds a new open_bars table (a separate progress bar per call)
